items.title: Vi Redd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: Yes, at the Newport Jazz Festival in 1968 I did, and that was a thrill, and I got to know him as a person.

ctx.x: Do you have a picture in your mind of what would be going on?

Something with children, or even a mystery, some kind of mystery. But I hear myself. I’m wanting to hear myself I guess I should say, in a movie. And Lalo Schifrin does movies and I met him when he was with Diz, and I’ve been saying I was going to call Lalo and let him know what my desire is. And often times people will say, “Jazz musicians? Do you read music?” Of course I read music. I had a guy ask me that one time. I was doing a record date for Rahsaan Roland Kirk. And he says, “Well do you read music?” And I…
